description: Delete a calendar event by id from the selected workspace. Removes the stored event, or cancels the post when the calendar uses scheduled posts as its backing store. Returns the deletion result. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_delete_calendar_event
title: Delete Calendar Event
